purpose: Pinned Git distribution shipped with the client so R1's managed Git never depends on the user's PATH. R1's GitAdapter accepts CRAFTMINE_BUNDLED_GIT or an exe-adjacent git/bin/git.exe and reports source=pathFallback otherwise.

archive.digestSource: GitHub release asset digest for v2.53.0.windows.1 (api.github.com/repos/git-for-windows/git/releases/tags/v2.53.0.windows.1), retrieved 2026-09-10

extracted.note: Raw archive: 384 files / 109017851 bytes. The package layout keeps that tree intact under resources/git/ and adds one wrapper copy at bin/git.exe (cmd/git.exe, 46480 bytes), so the staged tree is 385 files / 109064331 bytes. The stage tool recomputes both numbers and records them in the package.

layout.why: cmd/git.exe is the Git for Windows wrapper; it resolves its root from its own directory, so copying it to bin/git.exe with the tree one level up yields a working resources/git/bin/git.exe that matches the ../git/bin/git.exe candidate.

licence.note: MinGit also carries per-component licences under mingw64/share/licenses/** and usr/share/licenses/**; they ship with the tree and must not be stripped.
